title: Jonah and the Winter
author: O. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Petra Yarrow, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
